creator.identity_basis: Current explicit developer role, user-scoped invocation, exact on-disk Agent/Skill/Guideline/Prompt/Request loaded; invocation UUID is local attribution, not an external platform identity
creator.harness_evidence: get_current_session returned this session and canonical SupportIQ working directory; its title is not role proof

clock_basis: Python timezone-aware local system UTC sampled at record preparation; not exact publication time

gate.applicability: No formal product approval or acceptance gate is created or satisfied

task_context: Initial assessment; no approved Requirement, Plan, or Plan-local task
last_confirmed_boundary: Invocation published and independently freshly read back before substantive assessment

readback.clock_basis: Actual prior independent readback command stdout; not filesystem publication time
readback.ordering: Readback command completed before README/PRD semantic inspection

partial_outputs.target_inspection: README and all 524 word/document.xml paragraphs statically read; no macro, embedded executable, project command or runtime executed

unfinished_work: Publish evidence, report and bound result; independent fresh terminal readback
repository_effects: Own authorized records only; no source or other actor record writes
pending_human_decisions: Possible-blocker recommendations to be reported; no disposition supplied
safe_continuation_prerequisites: Inputs unchanged; remain in own scope; no later process; validate final bindings
